# NVIDIA Kubernetes Launch Kit Docs

This documentation covers the `l8k` CLI for deploying NVIDIA cloud-native networking on Kubernetes.

## Start

- Overview: /k8s-launch-kit/
- Plan your deployment: /k8s-launch-kit/user/profiles/
- Installation: /k8s-launch-kit/user/installation/
- First deployment: SR-IOV Ethernet: /k8s-launch-kit/user/quick-start/
- Networking concepts: /k8s-launch-kit/advanced/concepts/

## Deploy

- Discover cluster hardware: /k8s-launch-kit/user/discovery/
- Generate and review manifests: /k8s-launch-kit/advanced/generation/
- Deploy manifests: /k8s-launch-kit/advanced/deployment/
- Deploy on OpenShift: /k8s-launch-kit/user/openshift/
- Deploy Spectrum-X networking: /k8s-launch-kit/user/spectrum-x/
- Deploy to mixed hardware: /k8s-launch-kit/user/heterogeneous-clusters/
- Use topology presets: /k8s-launch-kit/user/presets/
- Use the network in an application: /k8s-launch-kit/user/workloads/

## Operate

- Validate and accept a deployment: /k8s-launch-kit/user/validation/
- Change and upgrade a deployment: /k8s-launch-kit/user/maintenance/
- Troubleshoot and collect evidence: /k8s-launch-kit/user/troubleshooting/
- Remove a deployment: /k8s-launch-kit/user/cleanup/

## Automate

- CI/CD and GitOps: /k8s-launch-kit/integrator/automation/
- Use AI agent skills: /k8s-launch-kit/integrator/ai-skills/

## Reference

- CLI reference: /k8s-launch-kit/reference/cli/
- Configuration reference: /k8s-launch-kit/reference/configuration/

## Contribute
